scenario.name: Microsoft Exchange/IIS IR, ESET & Unit 42 DFIR — IIS HTTP.sys Kernel URI Registration & In-Memory Module Forensics
scenario.overview: Imagine a grand city courthouse hall with fluted marble columns, an elevated wooden judge bench, a witness stand, and a brass wax-seal notary stamping desk. Entering the marble courthouse hall during a crowded docket, a forger requests a routine certified copy at the notary clerk’s brass stamping counter. In this real-world scenario, the intruder smuggles copied records out past the courtroom marble columns in tiny disguised batches, then leaves a hidden spare latch behind so they can walk back into the courthouse later. The court bailiff audits the official notary stamp registry and discovers stamped certificates that were never entered into the judge’s docket book. In this scenario (T1505.004, Microsoft Exchange/IIS IR, ESET & Unit 42 DFIR, IIS HTTP.sys Kernel URI Registration & In-Memory Module Forensics), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: native/Managed IIS Module Registration, then kernel-Mode HTTP.sys URI UrlGroup, then live Triage via netsh http show servicestate. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering Native/Managed IIS Module Registration, then Kernel-Mode HTTP.sys URI UrlGroup, then Live Triage via netsh http show servicestate, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection correlates Sysmon Event 7 with the documented host and network chain.

stages.title: Stage 2: Kernel-Mode HTTP.sys URI UrlGroup Registration (HttpService/Operational EventID 113)
stages.subtitle: Defense Evasion (T1505.004 - HTTP.sys Kernel Request Queue Hijacking)
stages.description: Taking advantage of an unguarded moment at the notary desk, the forger lifts the impression of the courthouse wax seal and stamps a stack of unauthorized passes offline. Here in Step 2 inside the courthouse, the intruder leaves a hidden spare latch behind so they can walk back into the courthouse later without disturbing the sealed judicial record vault. Alternatively, a post-exploitation implant calls HttpAddUrlToUrlGroup (httpapi.dll) to register a dedicated URI prefix (https://+:443/owa/auth/Current/themes/health/) directly in the kernel HTTP.sys driver.
